overview: A professional B2B corporate website for SS Enterprises, a company specializing in printing aluminium foils for FMCG and pharmaceutical industries. Features an About page, Products showcase, interactive Clients map, and Contact form.
features: Home page with hero section and company overview
About Us page with history, mission, and core values
Products page showcasing aluminium foil product categories
Clients page with interactive world map showing supply locations
Contact Us page with form and company details
Responsive layout for desktop and mobile
